_note: One entry per released version, newest last. free[] and pro[] are plain lines that every user sees (Free users see the Pro list too, it is public marketing copy like the pricing page). Plain benefit wording only: no engine, trick or recipe names. Anything internal belongs in the Pro pack's own whats_new_pro.json. A line is a string, or {"text": "...", "media": "/webapp/docs/..png"}. The release gate fails when the entry for VERSION is missing. Optional per version: "date" (YYYY-MM-DD), "headline" (one plain line under the version in the window header, the release in a sentence) and "hero", the big visual at the top of the card and the website changelog: {"kind": "vertical", "title", "original", "free", "pro"} (each {"video", "poster"}) or {"kind": "media", "video" or "image", "poster", "caption"}. "showcase" holds the standing "What Pro adds" items (measured, never projected) shown to Free users under New in Pro. Media goes in assets/whats_new/ (served at /assets/whats_new/; the website copies it with its sync script). Per version "how": [{"id", "title", "free": {"video", "poster", "caption"}, "pro": {...}}], a few seconds of the real Studio showing where the button is and what you get; every new feature gets one, and the feature links to it by id. Optional per version "pro_perks": ids from pro_perks.json (the one list of Pro speed-ups and features with their measured numbers); they lead the window as Now in Pro, above everything else, with a Get Pro button for Free users. A perk not yet released there (since null) is never shown.

pro.text: Pro makes 5-second H3 clips faster: 14:57 on Free, 10:02 on Pro, the same clip on the same Mac. 10 and 15-second H3 clips render at Free speed for now.

free: Pictures work on a fresh Mac app install. If the picture engine is missing, Phosphene adds it by itself, once.
A missing text-model file is named before a video starts, not after it fails.
Songs wait for memory on Macs with 24 GB or less, and say so, instead of failing partway.

pro: Your Pro licence stays on your Mac when you delete and reinstall Phosphene. No pasting your key again.
Lost your key? "Already paid? Restore Pro" emails it to you again.

free: Hailuo H3 now runs on 16 GB and 18 GB Macs. It needed 36 GB before. Free for everyone.
The version is easier to see. When an update is ready, look for the coloured Update to button.
See what changed after each update. Click the version to read it again.
In Mac app 5.0.8, Check for updates checks the app, Studio and Pro together.
pro: In Mac app 5.0.8, Pro checks for updates every 10 minutes while the app is open. It waits until your render finishes before switching.

free: Hailuo H3 clips now all play at the same loudness, whichever speed you pick.
Resuming a music download reuses engine code already on your Mac and keeps the model files already downloaded.
Mac app: download Hailuo H3 right inside Phosphene. Click Hailuo H3 in the engine switcher. If you quit halfway, it carries on where it stopped.
Music setup in the Mac app no longer needs Apple developer tools.
The Mac app keeps installed Speech and Music engines across updates, remembers your video generation choice, and waits for installs and downloads before updating.
Connect your agent from Help → Connect an agent in the Mac app.
pro: Clips from Pro's faster H3 lane now have full-volume sound.
Installing Speech and switching video generations no longer break the next Pro startup check.

free: Shot setup opens by default, with quieter prompt guidance and fewer distractions.
Orientation controls stay compact and aligned.
The Editor timeline stays clear of render progress panels, including in narrow windows.
Finished clips stay in preview until you return to the render or start another take.
Stop cancels the current render promptly.
Completion sounds no longer repeat when the history refreshes, and the visible Studio stays quiet.
Installed video models stay selectable when returning from Images.
Cleaner shot controls, with detailed explanations in Docs.
Timeline clips show a frame again in the Mac app, and say where they sit in the film.
Changing or removing the soundtrack now sticks in preview, render, save and export.
Drop pictures and clips onto the overlay lane; render progress and Cancel stay on screen.
Dragging a clip shows what it will do: move, reorder, ripple, slip, roll or trim.
Queued clips keep going while one engine updates, and the queue says what it is waiting for.
Plain messages when the video model is not downloaded yet, and when the engine restarts itself.
In the Mac app, the update notice says what is updating and when it is done.
Mac app wording now matches the app: no Pinokio instructions, and the right models folder.

5.0.15.headline: A new picture model, MiniMax-H3-Image, free for everyone.
free: New picture model: MiniMax-H3-Image, free for everyone. Text to image at 4, 8 or 16 megapixels. Preview.
It needs a Mac with 48 GB of memory or more, and downloads once the first time you use it.

5.0.16.headline: Make it vertical: a tall copy of any clip, from the More menu.
free: Make it vertical: a tall 9:16, 4:5 or square copy of any clip, with a soft blurred fill. In the More menu on any clip.
Timeline clips show a picture right away, before Prepare.
pro: Make it vertical (AI fill): real picture above and below, as if the clip was shot tall. For Macs with 48 GB or more.

hero.title: Make it vertical
hero.caption: The same clip, three ways. Free keeps the whole picture with a soft blurred fill. Pro paints real picture above and below.

free.label: Free: blurred fill
free.caption: Open More on a finished clip and pick Make it vertical. A tall copy with a soft blurred fill appears next to it in seconds.

pro.label: Pro: AI fill
pro.caption: Pick Make it vertical (AI fill) in the same menu. AI paints real picture above and below. About 15 minutes for a 5-second clip, on Macs with 48 GB or more.

5.0.17.headline: A bigger What's new, and every Pro feature marked where you use it.
free: A bigger What's new, with clips of what changed. Click the version number to see it again.
How Make it vertical works: a short clip shows where to click. In the More menu on any clip.
Clearer messages when a character training or a Control render cannot start: they name the photo or the download and say what to do.
A character training keeps going when you rename its trigger word after the captions are written.
pro: Your Pro: click the Pro badge next to the logo to see everything your licence turns on in this version, and where to find it.
Every Pro feature is marked where you use it, so you can see what is on with your licence.

free.label: Free: blurred fill
free.caption: Open More on a finished clip and pick Make it vertical. A tall copy with a soft blurred fill appears next to it in seconds.

pro.label: Pro: AI fill
pro.caption: Pick Make it vertical (AI fill) in the same menu. AI paints real picture above and below. About 15 minutes for a 5-second clip, on Macs with 48 GB or more.

5.0.18.headline: Faster LTX clips with Pro: about a quarter less waiting on a 5-second clip.
pro: Faster LTX clips: about a quarter less waiting on a 5-second LTX-2.5 clip, on by default on Macs with 32 GB or more. Untick Pro speed-up beside Quality to render a clip the usual way.

free.label: Free
free.caption: Pro adds about a quarter less waiting on LTX clips, on Macs with 32 GB or more.

pro.label: Pro
pro.caption: On by default beside Quality. Same clip, same seed: 152 s on Free, 113 s with Pro (M4 Max 64 GB).

free: MiniMax-H3-Image now edits your pictures. Drop a photo into Picture 1 in Images and say what to change; the result keeps the photo's shape.
Combine up to 6 pictures in one edit: name them in the prompt, like the hat from Picture 2 on the person in Picture 1.
Change the shape while editing: pick another shape and the model fills the new area, for example a tall poster made wide.
Edit this picture: in the More menu on any finished picture. It opens the picture in Images, so you can keep changing it.
Two more shapes for pictures: 3:2 and 2:3.
Fixed: the Upscale & Face Fix add-on no longer says it needs Q8 when Q8 is installed.
Phosphene Remote 0.4 is out for iPhone: every Studio workflow from your phone. Update it in the App Store.

free.label: Edit one picture
free.caption: Images, MiniMax-H3-Image: drop a photo into Picture 1 and say what to change. One picture at Draft took about 5 minutes on an M4 Max 64 GB.

free.label: Combine pictures
free.caption: Add a second picture and name it in the prompt. Two pictures at Draft took about 8 minutes on an M4 Max 64 GB.

5.0.19.headline: MiniMax-H3-Image now edits your pictures, and can combine up to 6 in one edit.

free: Video on 16 GB Macs needs far less memory: a clip peaks at about 5.7 GB instead of 9 GB, and a render with your trained characters or styles at about 6.7 GB instead of 19 GB. Same frames as before.
Mac app 5.0.20: keep your models on an external drive. Choose the folder at setup or in Settings, and move the models there or back later.
More first videos finish: if the Mac app's model download stopped, the Studio fetches the video model itself, and your first clip is sized to fit your Mac.
On a small Mac, a MiniMax H3 render that cannot get memory now waits its turn instead of failing every job behind it.
A cleaner What's new window: the headline, what is new for everyone and what is new in Pro, in one card.
pro: Faster LTX clips now reach 16 to 24 GB Macs too: about 27 to 30% faster than Free.
5.0.20.headline: Less memory on 16 GB Macs, models on an external drive, and more first videos that finish.

free: Videos with your trained characters or styles work again on 16 to 24 GB Macs. In 5.0.20 they stopped at the start with an error.
5.0.21.headline: Videos with your trained characters or styles work again on 16 to 24 GB Macs.

free: In the Mac app, Settings and Models now show Move to another drive, so you can keep your models on an external SSD.
5.0.22.headline: Keep your models on an external drive: Move to another drive is now in Settings, under Models.

free: Some trained characters and styles stopped videos on 16 to 24 GB Macs with an "Expected shape" error. They render now.
When macOS stops a video while it reads the prompt (most often on M1 and M2 Macs), Phosphene waits a moment and tries once more by itself instead of failing.
A picture or clip that a waiting render still needs can no longer be deleted by mistake. Phosphene says how many renders use it.
On Pinokio, a missing image engine now installs itself the first time you make a picture.
MiniMax H3: after macOS stops a render with a graphics error, later H3 renders on that Mac are handed to the graphics chip in smaller pieces, the remedy LTX videos already use.
Clearer messages when a 720p export fails or a song to cover cannot be read: they say why and what to do.
5.0.23.headline: Fewer failed renders: fixes for trained styles on small Macs, graphics stops on M1 and M2 Macs, and deleted inputs.

free: Phosphene speaks your language: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified). It follows your Mac, or pick one in Settings, Language.
The Pro window now says what Pro does on your Mac, shows both plans with their prices, the 14-day refund and how your key arrives.
5.0.24.headline: Phosphene now speaks your language: ten languages, picked from your Mac or in Settings.

free: Long LTX clips use a third less memory at the end of the render: on Macs over 32 GB, clips longer than 5 seconds finish in pieces. On a 10-second clip the peak drops from 20 GB to 12.7 GB, same speed.
5.0.25.headline: Long LTX clips use a third less memory at the end of the render, on every Mac over 32 GB.

free: Storyboard in Grid view: a shot with a problem is marked red and says what is wrong; the Render button names every problem instead of pointing at shots that were not on screen.
5.0.26.headline: Storyboard Grid view shows which shot has a problem, and the Render button names it.

free: Restyle a picture on Hailuo H3: drop in a photo or drawing, name the style (clay, flat vector, pixel art, felt), and get the same scene back in that style in about 2 minutes.
pro: Crisper detail on LTX-2.5 clips: a switch under the prompt for noticeably finer detail on Quick, Balanced and Standard clips, in about the same render time. Off by default.
5.0.27.headline: Restyle a picture on Hailuo H3 for everyone, and Crisper detail on LTX-2.5 clips for Pro.

free: P-H3-Image now tells you when it ignores a reference picture, and points to MiniMax-H3-Image, which can edit and reuse your pictures.
5.0.28.headline: P-H3-Image says when it ignores your reference picture.

free: The play and more buttons on song rows are now centred.
5.0.29.headline: Song row buttons are properly centred.

free: A reference picture you move or delete after attaching it no longer fails the render.
Songs on smaller Macs wait for memory after a video instead of stopping.
The picture engine repairs its own install when its first download was interrupted.
5.0.30.headline: Fixes: moved reference pictures, songs on small Macs, picture engine repair.

free: Song lyrics keep the hard parts of a dark or angry idea instead of turning them into greeting-card verse.
5.0.31.headline: Fix: song lyrics stay honest to your idea.

free: The update pop-up on Pinokio says plainly how to update, reaches Macs where GitHub's check is blocked, and remembers Later.
Mac app: developer notices now arrive, plus a quiet hint when an update is ready.
5.0.32.headline: Fix: update pop-up says how to update and reaches more Macs.

free: After an update, What's new shows what the release gave you first, then what is new in Pro.
A new install notes once where you found Phosphene (our website, Pinokio, or unknown) in the anonymous usage counts. It holds nothing about you; Settings, Anonymous usage analytics turns it off.
5.0.33.headline: Pro: Fast draft makes LTX-2.5 Balanced clips in about half the time, on any Mac with 16 GB or more.

free: Training goes on when captions don't name your trigger word: it is added to every caption.
Covers of busy songs no longer stop with 'transcription came out incomplete'.
FLUX 3 and image errors name the real reason, like no connection to Hugging Face.
A model file that cannot be opened says to reconnect the drive or press Repair.
5.0.34.headline: Fix: clearer errors, training and song covers that keep going.

free: Fewer LTX renders stopped by the graphics watchdog on M2 Pro and M2 Max Macs.
Hailuo H3 on 16-24 GB Macs uses the faster video finish more often: same frames, sooner.
5.0.35.headline: Fix: steadier LTX on M2 Pro/Max, faster H3 finish on 16-24 GB Macs.

free: Upscale x2 on Macs under 96 GB stops at 2048x1152, the size that fits, instead of being stopped for memory after a long wait.
5.0.36.headline: Fix: Upscale x2 on 64 GB Macs no longer runs out of memory.

free: A reference picture from your Desktop, Downloads or anywhere on your Mac is copied in and used, instead of the render failing.
Upscale x2 works on phone videos again: no more 'could not read the size' on clips with a rotation tag.
Qwen-Edit picture edits no longer stop with a GPU crash on M1, M2 and M4 Max; same picture.
A style file made for FLUX.1, picked for Auto or Klein pictures, is refused at once with a plain message, not halfway through.
Image-to-video carries on with the picture as is when its quick ffmpeg pass stalls, instead of failing.
5.0.37.headline: Fix: outside reference pictures, phone clips in Upscale, Qwen-Edit GPU crash, FLUX.1 style check, i2v stall.

free: When macOS's graphics driver stops a render, the message says Phosphene already retried and what to try, instead of a GitHub link that does not open.
5.0.38.headline: Fix: graphics-driver crash messages say what to try, not a dead GitHub link.

free: Video model downloads, including High quality, come from our open Hugging Face pages, so High works again while GitHub is down instead of failing with HTTP 404.
5.0.39.headline: Fix: big model downloads come from Hugging Face, so High quality works again.

free: Audio > Music Video: a song can be dragged into the song slot or picked with a click again, even after opening the Image Studio.
5.0.40.headline: Fix: the Music Video song slot takes a song again.
